title: Field notes
when: A report or conversation has a concrete place, person or event at its heart.
story: Open inside a sourced moment; reveal the context later; return to the opening detail.
picture: Observed places, objects and restrained lower thirds; lock the camera for data.
pace: A quiet opening, a change of scale at the turn, then an earned pause.
rules: Distinguish illustrative scenes from documented events.
Do not invent quotations or a witness.
